incident-bot: paging luis@channel: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed on /v1/generate (region: us-west-2). Error rate spike from 0.4% -> 12% in last 5m. Detected 429 cascade on downstream GA proxy. Impact: user-facing timeouts and API errors. :rotating_light:
Luis (oncall): seeing it, joining. pulling logs now.
Alyssa (SRE): I'm online. can someone paste the high-level graph?
Mike (Infra): Cloud LB metrics show 5xx from service pool "gen-ephemeral" jumped at 10:12:18 UTC. Backend returning 502/504 and some 429s.
Ravi (API): We pushed a rate-limit tweak for per-tenant quotas an hour ago (reduce burst for free tier). Could be related.
Jen (Support): Customer-facing alerts starting to come in — several enterprise customers reporting failed calls and increased latency. Salesforce case #12345 opened.
Luis (oncall): Alyssa, can you lead triage? I'm coordinating pages and incident doc.
Alyssa (SRE): On it. First check: are we seeing token bucket exhaustion on the rate-limiter?
Mike (Infra): Attaching quick excerpt of error stream:
```
[10:12:20] gateway proxy: upstream error: 502 Bad Gateway, backend=gen-ephemeral-17
[10:12:21] ratelimiter: tenant=acme corp, allowed=0, queued=145, dropped=39
[10:12:22] backend: kv cache miss spike 18x
```

Ravi (API): The ratelimiter started rejecting more requests after the quota change. We also saw an increase in retries from clients which amplified load. sounds like classic feedback amplification -> 429 -> client retry -> backend overwhelmed -> 5xx.
Luis (oncall): Customer impact: partial for hosted API, degraded serving for medium/large prompts, some embeddings jobs failing. Priority P1.
Alyssa (SRE): Short-term mitigation plan: 1) Temporarily relax per-tenant burst limits for 10m for affected routes, 2) throttle retries at gateway (exponential backoff header enforcement), 3) roll back the last quota tweak if rollback is fast, 4) create fallback route to lower-capacity model for large requests. Who can execute 1 and 3?
Mike (Infra): I can bump the burst config in the central rate-limiter cluster. Will do a scoped change for tenants tagged "enterprise" + "high-traffic". Applying now.
Ravi (API): I can revert the per-tenant config in the control plane if needed. will standby.
Jen (Support): Notifying top 10 customers via status page & support channel. Posting a short update.
Alyssa (SRE): Also enable rate-limiter debug logs for 5m to capture the token consumption pattern.
Mike (Infra): Patch applied: increased burst window for affected tenants from 50 -> 300 tokens for 10m. Pushing config to 3/3 nodes.
Ravi (API): Rolling back the quota tweak now. control-plane: revert change id abc123.
Luis (oncall): Can we also force gateway to add `Retry-After` and return 429 with proper backoff hints so clients don't immediately hammer again?
Alyssa (SRE): Good call. Mike, can you flip enforcement to include backoff headers?
Mike (Infra): Added `Retry-After` 10s to 429 responses and enabled client-side rate limiting at the ingress. Deployed to canary then to all.
Alyssa (SRE): Monitoring: error rate dropped from 12% -> 4% within 3m. Timeouts down 60%.
Ravi (API): Verified control-plane revert succeeded. New config matches pre-change state.
Jen (Support): Posted status: "We are seeing partial service degradation; mitigation in progress. ETA 30m." Customers acknowledged.
Luis (oncall): Handing off to Alyssa for next 1 hour. I'll follow up with postmortem owner.
Alyssa (SRE): I'll keep watch. Next steps: collect logs, identify why retries spiked (client misbehavior or missing Retry-After), evaluate a long-term fix to ratelimiter token refill math and queued request handling (avoid head-of-line blocking).
Mike (Infra): Noted one issue: our autoscaler had a slow scale-up due to incorrect metric namespace—so backend CPU spiked and pods went unhealthy, contributing to 502/504. I'll file infra task to fix autoscaler metric mapping.
Ravi (API): Also observed an edge case where internal service-to-service retries didn't respect `Retry-After`. We'll add the header propagation fix.
Alyssa (SRE): Current status: mitigation effective, error rate at 1.8% now and trending down. Rolling mitigation plan back in 10m to observe.
Jen (Support): Updated customers: "Mitigations in place, errors decreasing; continue to monitor. Will update within 1h."
Luis (oncall): Thanks team — I'm unpaging. Alyssa, please capture timeline and own the postmortem.
Alyssa (SRE): Will do. Preliminary RCA hypothesis: quota config change reduced burst allowances -> increased 429 -> client retries amplified traffic -> backend capacity/auto-scaling lag -> cascading 5xx. Action items: (A) postmortem doc, (B) patch ratelimiter to emit `Retry-After` and enforce gateway backoff, (C) fix autoscaler metric namespace, (D) add canary checks for quota changes, (E) update runbook for immediate mitigation steps.
Mike (Infra): I'll open infra tickets for (C) and (B) and link to the postmortem.
Ravi (API): I'll add a CI check that flags per-tenant quota changes that lower burst by >50% without a canary.
Jen (Support): I'll close the top customer cases once metrics remain stable for 2h.
incident-bot: incident acknowledged: severity=P1, owner=Alyssa (SRE), start_ts=1745003421. Postmortem due in 72h.
Alyssa (SRE): Thanks all. Logging final note: if anyone observed anomalies in the ratelimiter metrics beyond what's in the logs, paste them here.
Mike (Infra): Not seeing further anomalies. lowering alert thresholds; will follow up in infra channel with tickets.
Alyssa (SRE): Marking this thread resolved. Will publish postmortem draft in #postmortems and ping oncall. :white_check_mark:
